one message in, one calm path down, the same order every time

g.text: WhatsApp · Instagram · web · native iOS app (Swift/SwiftUI)
route handlers forward to Rails, so tokens never reach the browser
tenant middleware → JWT (refresh rotation) → roles & permissions
Claude agents (~18 tools) · follow-ups engine · Stripe · SAT CFDI

Kamal → DigitalOcean · GitHub Actions on self-hosted runners
